exact: glycosylceramide flippase activity (exoplasmic to cytosolic leaflet)

definition: Catalysis of the movement of glycosylceramide from the exoplasmic to the cytosolic leaflet of a membrane, using energy from the hydrolysis of ATP. Glycosylceramides are ceramides containing a functional group derived from a sugar.
label: glycosylceramide flippase activity
